title: Jumping Polish Cabbage Soup
description: A briny and pillowy Polish cabbage soup infused with hot smoked paprika and a hint of binchotan charcoal, served in a copper mug to boost energy and flavor.
instructions: Chop the cabbage into thin shreds and set aside.
Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and finely slice the carrot and celery.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the onion, garlic, carrot, and celery to the pot and sauté until the vegetables are softened and fragrant.
Stir in the shredded cabbage and cook for another 3 minutes, letting it wilt slightly.
Sprinkle in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, mixing thoroughly to coat all the vegetables.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Just before serving, stir in the binchotan charcoal powder and let it dissolve for 2 minutes, allowing the soup to develop a subtle smoky depth.
Ladle the hot soup into a clean copper mug, ensuring the liquid stays warm.
Garnish with a pinch of freshly ground pepper and enjoy the energizing flavors.
